findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_client_dossier, get_client_reviews_due, get_email_messages, get_email_detail · Private data: list_documents, get_document_detail, update_eam_client, complete_review, delete_document, create_share_link, upload_document, update_document, extract_document_data, link_email_to_client · Public sink: get_document_detail, complete_review, create_share_link, upload_document, get_email_messages, get_email_detail, link_email_to_client · Destructive: delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_client_dossier, get_client_reviews_due, get_email_messages, get_email_detail · Private data: list_documents, get_document_detail, update_eam_client, complete_review, delete_document, create_share_link, upload_document, update_document, extract_document_data, link_email_to_client · Public sink: get_document_detail, complete_review, create_share_link, upload_document, get_email_messages, get_email_detail, link_email_to_client · Destructive: delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
